# SpaceCorps Documentation · LLM Agent Index

> Comprehensive technical documentation for SpaceCorps systems, the Space3d engine, molecular dynamics simulation, and agent orchestration.

- Documentation Hub: https://spacecorps.github.io/docs.html
- Markdown Docs: https://spacecorps.github.io/docs.md
- Developer Portal: https://spacecorps.github.io/developers.html
- OpenAPI Specification: https://spacecorps.github.io/openapi.json
- Pricing & Quotas: https://spacecorps.github.io/pricing.md
- SpaceCorps 2027 MMO: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/

## Core Systems
1. **SpaceCorps 2027 MMO**: Cross-platform 2D space simulation, client binaries, and multiplayer telemetry.
2. **Space3d Game Engine**: Pure-Rust wgpu graphics engine with indirect rendering drawing 1,000,000+ instances.
3. **Space3d-Molecular**: High-performance atomistic molecular dynamics (`spacemd`) and thermal-field electron emission (`spaceemit`).
4. **Agent Tools**: 23 single-binary Rust command-line tools for multi-agent workflows.
